verdict.rationale: The openness axis applies to an AI assistant and model product, but the pack has no first-party evidence of a public source repository or an open license for Kimi's apps, CLI or code. The only related items are community remarks calling the model "open-weight" or "open source" (kimi-comm-1, kimi-comm-11). Open weights is an adjacent property, not readable product source under a documented license, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
